title: Optimality-Informed Neural Networks for Solving Parametric Optimization Problems
abstract: arXiv:2512.20270v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many engineering tasks require solving families of nonlinear constrained optimization problems, parametrized in setting-specific variables. This is computationally demanding, particularly if solutions have to be computed across strongly varying parameter values, e.g., in real-time control or for model-based design. Thus, we propose to learn the mapping from parameters to the primal optimal solutions and to their corresponding duals using neural networks, giving a dense estimation in contrast to gridded approaches. Our approach, Optimality-Informed Neural Networks (OptINNs), combines (i) a KKT-residual loss that penalizes violations of the first-order optimality conditions under standard constraint qualification assumptions, and (ii) problem-specific output activations that enforce simple inequality constraints (e.g., box-type/positivity) by construction. translated_title: 用于求解参数化优化问题的最优性信息神经网络
translated_abstract: 许多工程任务需要求解一族以场景特定变量为参数的非线性约束优化问题，其计算开销很大，尤其是当解需要在变化剧烈的参数值范围内计算时，例如在实时控制或基于模型的设计中。因此，我们提出利用神经网络学习从参数到原始最优解及其对应对偶变量的映射，与网格化方法相比可提供稠密的估计。我们的方法——最优性信息神经网络，结合了：(i) 在标准约束规范假设下惩罚违反一阶最优性条件（KKT条件）的残差损失；(ii) 通过构造方式强制满足简单不等式约束（如箱型/正性约束）的针对具体问题的输出激活函数。这一设计减少了数据需求，并支持对偶变量的预测……
tldr: 提出OptINNs方法，通过KKT残差损失与内嵌约束的输出激活函数，利用神经网络学习参数到原始最优解及对偶变量的映射，从而高效求解参数化优化问题并大幅降低数据需求。
en_tdlr: Optimality-Informed Neural Networks (OptINNs) learn the mapping from parameters to primal optimal solutions and their dual variables by combining a KKT-residual loss with problem-specific output activations that enforce simple constraints, enabling dense, data-efficient solutions to parametric optimization problems.
